**Reference Number:** R2876172

**Position Title:** 2027 Digital Graduate Program, Product Analyst, Data and AI Engineer

**Department:** Platform Engineering

**Location:** Toronto, ON

**Grade:** L2-1

**About the job**

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

  

Join Sanofi’s Data & AI platform engineering team and play a key role in advancing analytics, AI, and ML initiatives that shape the future of healthcare. As a Data & AI Engineer, you’ll design and deliver scalable solutions, and collaborate closely with leadership and teams to address both immediate and long-term business needs. Enjoy opportunities to learn from experts across technical and business domains, and drive impactful, data-driven innovation.

  

**About Sanofi**

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.​

  

We are Sanofi, an innovative global healthcare company that chases the miracles of science to improve people's lives. As an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma leader, we work across 100 countries to transform the practice of medicine by turning the impossible into the possible. Our expertise spans vaccines, rare diseases, rare blood disorders, neurology, immunology, oncology, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. Guided by our core values - Aim Higher, Act for Patients, Be Bold, and Lead Together - we provide life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions globally while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

  

**Main responsibilities:**

- Design, develop, and maintain Data and AI platform engineering solutions based on business requirements and design specifications using appropriate tools and technologies.
- Build, deploy Data and AI pipeline using LLMs and Embedding model from Bedrock and Snowflake Cortex (prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agents, and foundation model customization) and Snowflake Cortex functions (e.g., complete, summarize, embed\_text, Cortex Search/Analyst) and Snowflake with responsible AI guardrails, and continuously monitor model performance, data and concept drift, and inference and compute costs (token usage), optimizing pipelines and models accordingly.
- Partner with business, data engineering, and platform teams to identify high-value AI use cases and take them from ideation to production, mentor teams on best practices, and stay current on emerging AI/ML tools to accelerate time-to-value.
- Ensure developed solutions meet functional and technical requirements through rigorous testing and validation.
- Design, build, and maintain robust data and AI pipeline on AWS and Snowflake Cloud in support of our data mesh architecture.
- Work closely with global teams across North America, Europe, and India to align with data governance strategies and implement metadata management solutions.
- Ensure data security, compliance, and governance at every stage of the data platform, following global standards and best practices.
- Develop foundational knowledge in implementing data warehouses, data lakes, and distributed processing technologies such as Spark, Hadoop, and Kafka in production environments.
- Develop advanced proficiency with SQL (preferably Snowflake) and both relational and non-relational databases to optimize complex queries and data manipulation.
- Develop mastery in programming languages (like Python, Shell scripting, and Scala/Java) for the development of sophisticated data and AI engineering solutions.
- Work within cross-functional agile teams to contribute to the architecture and deployment of hybrid-cloud solutions and automated pipelines, ensuring seamless and high-performance data processing.
- Engage actively within the data and AI engineering community by sharing insights, best practices, and innovations that contribute to broader industry progress.

  

**About you**

You are enthusiastic about building your skills as a data or cloud engineer and eager to contribute to impactful projects. You have some experience with back-end or front-end technologies and a strong interest in developing reliable, practical solutions. You enjoy learning new things, working with others, and are motivated to help the team succeed. With a collaborative spirit and a desire to grow, you communicate clearly and are always ready to take on new challenges alongside experienced colleagues.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

- Must have participated in the Sanofi Co-Op program at some point during 2025 or 2026 and be eligible for a May 2027 start date.
- Must be legally authorized to work for Sanofi in Canada.

- Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
- Strong technical proficiency in data warehouse ecosystems (e.g., Snowflake).
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and familiarity with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture.
- Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM technologies (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or similar foundation model platforms), including prompt engineering and model fine-tuning/customization.
- 1+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, with advanced skills in SQL and programming languages like Python.
- Proven ability to solve complex business problems using data modeling and statistical analysis techniques.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Solid understanding of data governance, including data quality, integration, and security.
- Knowledge of data protection regulations and best practices (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira.
- Business knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry is a plus.
- Experience in building AI platforms or contributing to data science projects is preferred.

  

**Nice to Have:**

- Experience in the life sciences/pharmaceutical industry.
- Familiarity with Data Mesh concepts such as data as a product, Understanding of Data Management principles, data governance best practices
- Proficiency in at least one Metadata Management Tool (Collibra or Informatica)

  

If you are a Data or Cloud Engineer looking for an exciting opportunity to shape the future of healthcare through data-driven insights and transformative solutions, we encourage you to apply for this key position. Join us in making a significant impact on the lives of global patients and customers through innovative data engineering solutions. We look forward to hearing from you!

Applications received after the official close date will be reviewed on an individual basis.​

This position is for a new vacant role that is now open for applications.​

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding career opportunities.
  
  
The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation is responsible for the policies, legislation, regulations, programs, and services that enable Alberta’s agriculture and food sectors to flourish and contribute to economic growth and Albertans’ wellbeing. The ministry’s role is varied, ranging from maintaining food safety and fostering agricultural stability and growth, to increasing investment and supporting prosperity in rural Alberta. The ministry also delivers foundational programs to irrigation and agricultural societies that help create strong rural communities and resilient agriculture sectors.
  
  
****Role Responsibilities****
Put your data analysis and Geographic Information System (GIS) expertise to work protecting animal health in Alberta. In this specialized role, you’ll provide technical expertise in geospatial analytics, GIS mapping services and decision-support tools for Ministry staff and external stakeholders to support livestock disease surveillance, prevention, preparedness and response. Your work will help government and industry partners make timely, evidence-based decisions when they matter most.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

- Gather, analyze, validate and interpret complex animal health, laboratory and traceability data to support evidence-based decision-making.
- Lead the analysis and quality assurance of Premises Identification (PID) data used for disease surveillance, disease response, emergency preparedness, traceability and notifications.
- Develop advanced GIS maps, spatial analyses, models and dashboards to identify disease trends and support surveillance, outbreak response and operational planning.
- Lead the development and continuous improvement of GIS standards, methodologies, spatial data practices and decision-support tools.
- Produce accurate, timely mapping and analytical products to support disease response, foreign animal disease planning, market access and emergency exercises.
- Provide expert advice on data quality, governance, analytical methodologies, GIS applications and interpretation of complex datasets.
- Support disease outbreak response by identifying at-risk livestock populations, generating producer notification lists and providing information to government and industry partners.
- Monitor animal health data and disease reports, identify anomalies and emerging concerns, and provide analysis to support surveillance activities.
- Collaborate with government, industry and regulatory partners on animal health surveillance, traceability, data quality and disease-response initiatives.

The Job Description is provided for further details on this position.

**Who We Are**

We’re not your typical non-profit. We bring swagger to everything we do. That means we move with purpose in every step, driven by our commitment to putting our community at the centre of our work. Every day, we ask ourselves to see possibilities where others see limits. Because people with Parkinson’s and care partners deserve better. Better care, more inclusive research and access to treatment and support that make living well possible.

Our mission is to empower and inspire people living with Parkinson’s and their care partners to live fully and courageously. Through community support, advocacy, and research, we encourage others to see a diagnosis not as a dimming of light, but a spark for a new beginning.

Move forward. Together. On Mission.

**The Role**

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for transforming organizational data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making across Parkinson Canada. The role develops and maintains data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical frameworks to support organizational reporting and performance measurement across programs, fundraising, donor engagement, research, and other organizational initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst applies analytical and statistical methods to identify trends, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure data is accurate, accessible, and aligned with organizational priorities

The position provides structure to data collection, modelling, governance, and reporting processes, ensuring that information is accessible, accurate, consistent, and aligned with organizational objectives. Working collaboratively across departments, the Senior Data Analyst supports data-informed decision-making, strengthens organizational data capabilities, and promotes best practices in data quality, governance, and stewardship.

**This role is remote-based, with occasional in-person time for team and stakeholder collaboration. Travel is expected to be minimal, primarily within the Toronto area as needed.**

**What You Bring:**

- 5-8 years of progressive experience in data analysis, ideally within non-profit, healthcare, or mission-driven organizations, working with reporting tools and structured datasets.
- Master's degree in statistics, data science, economics, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
- Experience working with SQL and at least one BI/visualization tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
- Comfortable working in spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) at an advanced level
- Proficiency in either Python or R for analysis.
- Experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes, integrating data from multiple source systems, and working with data warehousing environments, including raw, transformed, and curated data layers.
- Experience applying statistical methods and analytical techniques, including segmentation, regression analysis, and predictive modelling, to support business decision-making.
- Strong analytical judgment with the ability to prioritize business needs, identify meaningful metrics, and communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Knowledge of data governance, data quality, privacy standards, and ethical data practices (and AI tools, where relevant), with experience developing accurate, well-documented, and repeatable reporting and analytical processes.
- Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships with stakeholders, translate business questions into analytical solutions, and communicate findings in a clear and actionable manner.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment, managing competing priorities and adapting to changing organizational needs

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Data Analysis, Reporting & Statistical Insights*

- Lead the design, development, and maintenance of dashboards and reports to monitor program performance, fundraising results, donor engagement, and pilot initiatives (e.g., the Hub).
- Analyze raw data and translate findings into meaningful, actionable insights to support organizational decision-making.
- Identify trends, patterns, performance gaps, and opportunities across programs and fundraising activities.
- Apply statistical methods, including segmentation, regression, and predictive modelling, to identify patterns in program engagement and donor behaviour.
- Go beyond descriptive reporting to understand what the data indicates, what may be driving results, and what actions teams should consider.

*Data Engineering, Quality & Governance*

- Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines that extract information from source systems, including CRM and engagement platforms, program databases, and pilot initiative databases.
- Clean, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources into a shared organizational data model.
- Develop processes to match and de-duplicate records across systems, particularly where common identifiers do not exist.
- Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and risks in data collection, storage, and management practices.
- Work with technical partners to improve data models, pipelines, data structures, and overall data quality.
- Uphold data privacy and governance standards, ensuring sensitive information related to program participants and donors is handled in accordance with privacy best practices, data minimization principles, and organizational policies.

*Metrics, Performance Measurement & Reporting Standards*

- Collaborate with stakeholders to define and establish key organizational metrics and performance indicators.
- Ensure consistent metric definitions and reporting practices across teams.
- Maintain a single source of truth for organizational reporting.
- Support consistent and reliable measurement of program performance, fundraising outcomes, donor engagement, and pilot initiatives.

*Stakeholder Collaboration & Strategic Recommendations*

- Work closely with Mission, Marketing and Communications, Philanthropy, and the Executive Leadership Team to understand organizational priorities, reporting needs, and key business questions.
- Translate stakeholder questions into relevant, timely, and meaningful data analysis.
- Present findings and recommendations in a clear and accessible way to support strategic and operational decision-making.
- Identify what is driving organizational results and provide evidence-based recommendations for consideration.
- Participate in Parkinson Canada's EOS operating framework, including regular meeting rhythms, quarterly priorities (Rocks), and defined role accountabilities.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

We are looking for a Data Analyst / Data Architect with strong Transfer Agency (TA) experience. You will design, model and govern the data behind unitholder recordkeeping, fund transactions, distributions and dealer relationships. You will work between Operations, Distribution, Finance, Compliance and Technology to turn TA data from outsourced and in-house platforms into trusted, well-documented data products. These products support reporting, analytics, regulatory obligations and the move to the cloud.

  

The role is both hands-on and architectural. You will write SQL and analyze source data, and you will also define target-state data models, integration patterns and data quality controls for the TA domain.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

**Transfer Agency Data Analysis**

- Analyze TA data across the full unitholder lifecycle: account setup, KYC/AML, purchases, redemptions, switches, transfers, systematic plans (PAC/SWP), distributions and reinvestments, fees, trailers and commissions.
- Profile and reconcile data from TA platforms (e.g., IFDS/SS&C, FundSERV order flows, dealer and intermediary files) against fund accounting, custody and general ledger records.
- Investigate breaks and data issues, find root causes and work with Operations and vendors to fix them for good.
- Turn business questions from Distribution, Sales, Finance and Compliance into clear data requirements, mappings and analytical outputs.

  

**Data Architecture & Modelling**

- Design and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models for the TA domain, including investor/account, dealer/advisor, fund/series/class, transaction, holdings/positions, distributions, and fee/trailer entities.
- Define the target-state architecture for TA data on the enterprise cloud platform (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake), including ingestion, curated layers (bronze/silver/gold or equivalent) and consumption patterns.
- Set integration standards for batch file feeds, APIs and event-driven flows between the TA, fund accounting, CRM (e.g., Salesforce), data warehouse and reporting tools.
- Build source-to-target mappings, data lineage and transformation logic that engineers can implement and auditors can follow.

  

**Data Governance & Quality**

- Own TA business definitions, metric dictionaries and critical data elements (e.g., AUM by dealer, net sales, gross sales, redemptions, unitholder counts).
- Design and monitor data quality rules, reconciliation controls and exception workflows.
- Help classify and protect sensitive investor data (PII), in line with privacy, records retention and information security standards.
- Work with Data Governance on metadata, data catalog entries, ownership and stewardship.

  

**Regulatory & Reporting Support**

- Supply accurate data for regulatory and statutory obligations, such as client reporting (CRM2 cost and performance reports), tax reporting (T3, T5, NR4, RL slips), FATCA/CRS, AML/FINTRAC, unclaimed property and fund-level filings.
- Support sales and distribution analytics, dealer compensation, flow reporting and executive dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

  

**Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement**

- Act as the TA data subject-matter expert on modernization, migration and vendor-change projects.
- Write clear artifacts: requirements, data models, mapping specifications, test cases and runbooks.
- Support UAT, parallel runs and data validation during system changes and cloud migrations.
- Mentor analysts and engineers on TA business processes and data concepts.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

- 5+ years in data analysis, data architecture or data engineering in asset management, wealth management or fund services.
- 2+ years working directly with Transfer Agency data and processes (mutual funds, ETFs, pooled funds or alternatives).
- Solid knowledge of the TA business: unitholder recordkeeping, order processing, NAV-based settlement, distributions, trailers/commissions, dealer and intermediary structures, and fund series/class setups.
- Hands-on experience with at least one major TA platform or service provider (e.g., IFDS, SS&C DST, CIBC Mellon, RBC Investor Services, or similar) and with FundSERV or similar order-routing networks.
- Advanced SQL; experience with large relational and cloud data platforms.
- Proven data modelling skills (dimensional and normalized), with tools such as ER/Studio, Erwin or equivalent.
- Experience designing data pipelines and integration patterns (ETL/ELT, file-based feeds, APIs).
- Good understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management and lineage.
- Strong communication skills; able to explain complex data topics to operations staff, technologists and senior leaders.
- University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering or a related field.
- Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, Snowflake or GCP equivalents.
- Python or PySpark for data analysis, automation and validation.
- Knowledge of Canadian fund regulation and industry bodies (NI 81-102, NI 31-103, CIRO, CSA, IFIC) and client-reporting rules (CRM2).
- Exposure to fund accounting, custody and investment book of record (IBOR) data, and how they reconcile with TA records.
- Experience with TA platform conversions, vendor migrations or fund mergers.
- Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and semantic-layer design.

Community Health Centres of Northumberland is a community-centred primary healthcare facility serving Northumberland County, Ontario. As part of The Alliance for Healthier Communities, it provides community-based services and responds to local health concerns, including barriers to accessing care.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Clinical Director, the Data and Financial Analyst supports the Community Health Centres of Northumberland's (CHCN) financial management, data analysis, quality improvement, and internal and external reporting requirements. Working closely with the IT Systems Administrator, Accountant, and management team, the position develops, compiles, and maintains reports and interactive dashboards for internal and external audiences, including funder reporting and key performance indicators.

The position ensures data quality through ongoing quality control and assurance activities and coordinates corporate and external reporting requirements. It takes a lead role in organizational quality improvement initiatives, including development of the annual Quality Improvement Plan (QIP) and program evaluations. The position also supports organizational planning and decision-making through data collection and analysis, budget forecasting, research, and evaluation, while identifying and responding to data and financial information needs across CHCN programs. The Data and Financial Analyst serves as the agency’s lead resource for data analysis and reporting, ensuring that reporting processes and outputs align with organizational needs and support effective operational, financial, and quality improvement activities.

**COMPETENCY PROFILE:**

**SKILLS**

- Advanced analytical and technical skills to extract, cleanse, integrate, interpret, and present complex financial, clinical, and operational data through accurate reports and interactive dashboards gained through post secondary education and extensive experience.
- Strong communication, training, and collaboration skills to explain findings, advise management, support system users, and translate business requirements into effective reporting and workflow solutions.

**KNOWLEDGE**

- Knowledge of accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, financial controls,[MB1] [BA2] audit support, and the reporting requirements of government and other funding organizations.
- Strong knowledge of database administration, electronic medical records, data-quality practices, performance indicators, program evaluation, and the operating context of not-for-profit health care services.

**JUDGMENT**

- Exercises sound judgment in assessing data validity, identifying financial or reporting risks, investigating discrepancies, and determining appropriate corrective actions or recommendations.
- Applies professional discretion when balancing competing priorities, interpreting complex information, assessing the impact of budget or program changes, and advising management on evidence-informed decisions.

**ACCOUNTABILITY**

- Accountable for the accuracy, completeness, confidentiality, and timely delivery of financial, data-quality, performance, and funder reports across the organization.
- Accountable for maintaining effective controls, audit and feedback processes, documentation standards, and project deliverables, and for escalating significant risks, shortfalls, surpluses, or compliance concerns to management.

**Description**  
 **Vacancy Status:**  This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.   
 **AI Disclosure:**  As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role   
This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.   
**The Team & Opportunity**  
The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.   
We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.   
The ideal candidate combines strong data quality and validation fundamentals with a focus on automation and continuous improvement. They are comfortable working closely with data engineering, business analysis, governance, and business stakeholders to define quality expectations, detect and resolve data issues, and ensure enterprise data is complete, accurate, consistent, and aligned with schema requirements across legacy and cloud environments.   
**The Role**  
As a Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data, you will continuously monitor and assess the quality of data within the enterprise data warehouse. You will help ensure that data is complete, accurate, consistent, timely, and compliant with defined schema and business requirements.   
This role focuses on designing, automating, and maintaining data validation and quality controls across data pipelines and warehouse environments. You will work closely with the Data Engineering team to embed checks into data workflows and with the Business Analyst to understand business rules, data definitions, and stakeholder expectations. You will investigate exceptions, coordinate issue resolution, and provide clear visibility into data quality and remediation status. The role supports both the existing legacy environment and its migration to a cloud-based implementation, which may be Azure/Databricks or Google Cloud Platform.   
**Key Responsibilities**  

- Develop, automate, and maintain data-quality checks to monitor completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness across enterprise data.
- Define and implement schema validation controls to confirm that data structures, formats, data types, required fields, and constraints meet agreed requirements.
- Build automated validation into data ingestion, transformation, and publishing workflows in partnership with data engineers.
- Create repeatable checks for record counts, null values, duplicates, referential integrity, domain values, business rules, and cross-source reconciliation.
- Monitor data-quality results and pipeline outputs on an ongoing basis; identify anomalies, unexpected changes, and emerging quality trends.
- Establish alerting and exception-management processes so that data issues are detected, prioritized, communicated, and resolved promptly.
- Investigate data-quality incidents by tracing issues across source systems, transformations, schemas, and downstream consumers.
- Partner with data engineers to identify root causes, define corrective actions, and prevent recurring defects through improved controls and automation.
- Work with the Business Analyst and business stakeholders to translate business rules, data definitions, and quality expectations into clear, testable validation criteria.
- Support data migration and modernization by defining and executing validation and reconciliation plans for legacy-to-cloud data, including parallel-run comparisons where appropriate.
- Verify that migrated data conforms to target schemas, transformation logic, and agreed business rules while supporting continuity of existing data services.
- Maintain data-quality dashboards, scorecards, exception reports, and operational metrics that provide clear visibility into quality levels and remediation progress.
- Document validation rules, test results, defects, root causes, remediation actions, and quality standards.
- Support data governance practices by helping maintain data definitions, quality thresholds, ownership, lineage, and control documentation.
- Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, defect prioritization, demos, and continuous improvement with the data delivery team.
- Participate in incident reviews and recommend improvements to validation coverage, monitoring, processes, and operational readiness.

  
**Required Qualifications and Skills**  

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Demonstrated experience in data quality, data validation, data analysis, quality assurance, data engineering, or a related field.
- Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing data in relational databases or enterprise data warehouse environments.
- Experience creating and executing data validation, reconciliation, and quality tests for production or business-critical data.
- Experience automating repetitive data checks using Python, SQL, or comparable scripting and programming tools.
- Understanding of relational data structures, schemas, data types, keys, constraints, and data integration concepts.
- Ability to translate business rules and data requirements into measurable and repeatable validation criteria.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to identify patterns, isolate root causes, and assess downstream impacts.
- Experience tracking data defects, documenting findings, coordinating resolution, and verifying corrective actions.
- Familiarity with data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes, including how data is ingested, transformed, and delivered to consumers.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple quality issues and priorities.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

- Experience supporting data quality in an enterprise data warehouse, especially in an Oracle-based environment.
- Experience supporting data warehouse modernization or migration to Azure, Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud platforms.
- Familiarity with data-quality automation frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ, dbt tests, or equivalent tools.
- Experience using Python libraries and automation patterns to build repeatable data testing and monitoring solutions.
- Familiarity with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent cloud data and lakehouse platforms.
- Experience with data observability, anomaly detection, automated alerting, and data-quality dashboards.
- Familiarity with data governance concepts including data ownership, metadata, lineage, classification, and quality thresholds.
- Experience defining and monitoring data-quality metrics, scorecards, service targets, or operational controls.
- Experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, or integrating automated tests into data pipeline delivery.
- Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tools for defect tracking and documentation.
- Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with enterprise data, security, or privacy requirements.

  
 **Compensation:**    
The salary range for this role is $76,100 to $114,300. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.   
GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need gm immigration sponsorship now or in the future.

**Welcome to Specsavers** – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians. 

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

**What You’ll Do**

The **Data Analyst** delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.
